# ChunkGPU

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/renderer/terrain/`](../folders/src-renderer-terrain.md)
> **Source:** [`src/renderer/terrain/terrain_sys.h`](../../../src/renderer/terrain/terrain_sys.h)

## Summary

GPU mesh slot of a chunk entity: index into TerrainBuffers::vertices and the indirect draw buffer.

## Description

Emplaced (emplace_or_replace) by TerrainSys::tick on a chunk entity in the same frame its marching cubes dispatch is recorded. `slot` indexes TerrainBuffers::vertices and the indirect command at offset slot * TerrainBuffers::indirect_stride. When a chunk is re-meshed its previous slot is queued for reuse and replaced by a new one; when the chunk entity is destroyed (ChunkDestroying) its slot is queued too. Queued slots return to the free list only after more than NUM_FRAMES + 1 (= 4) TerrainSys ticks, so frames in flight never see a recycled buffer. Slots are in [0, TerrainSys::max_slots = 2048). TerrainSys::init creates the storage up front so the passes can view it from worker threads; TerrainSys's destructor clears it. Read by TerrainPass and GrassPass (together with ChunkReady).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slot` | `uint32_t` | uninitialized (always set by TerrainSys) | Mesh slot index, < 2048. |
